entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What's it like turning into a car, anyway?[n]Does your body just get bigger and[n]bigger?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmm, it's hard to describe. One[n]moment I'm normal, and then the[n]next, BAM! It's car time!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, I don't get it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, I've been wonderin'... What[n]made you think you could turn into[n]a car?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's kinda weird, man. Do people just go[n]around daily life, thinkin' about turnin'[n]into cars and shit?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll have you know I thought long and[n]hard about the challenges we'd have to[n]overcome. I used that as training.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You all should be thanking me for the[n]fruits of my rigorous efforts!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, yeah, okay. Thanks, Cargana!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you're gonna give me a nickname,[n]at least make it sound cool.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, it was wild the first time I saw this.[n]Who knew that guy could transform?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He even had a little pose for it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How long did you practice that routine,[n]Morgana?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't be ridiculous! It's not like I spent[n]time preparing!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So you just came up with it on the spot?[n]That's kinda weird too, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Meow?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ugh, don't play dumb with me!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's just give him this one.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Morgana was able to turn into this[n]because of the public's cognition of[n]driveable cats.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: In other words, if we can convince[n]people that a girl named Futaba Sakura[n]can turn into one too...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then it's car time for me too, baby!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's so smart! Would you be called[n]the Futaba Car?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Futaba Car...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Never mind, that sounds so lame. Hurgh,[n]that really throws a wrench in my plans!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why do you want to be a car in the[n]first place?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This car was a lot more comfortable than[n]I expected. I can't say I mind it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, have you forgotten how bumpy[n]that shit was in Mementos? I thought[n]my ass was gonna split in half.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Agreed on the bumpiness. It was rather[n]effective at abating my hunger, though.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I don't usually ride in cars with such[n]weak suspension.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It was a new experience for me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: THAT'S what you call it!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The seats in that thing are so warm.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It was kinda creepy at first, but once[n]you get used to it, it's nice and cozy.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know! It's warm, like a cat. It makes[n]me so sleepy!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But then the bumps in the road jolt[n]me awake again.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see that while I was controlling my[n]hunger, you all had your own set of[n]problems...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Drivin' around Mementos, escapin' from[n]Palaces while they're fallin' apart...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, that takes me back.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't forget the time we had to chase[n]him down in Mementos.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He was way too fast for us in car form...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: No matter whether Morgana-senpai is[n]a cat or a car, I can see he's an integral[n]member of the team.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Hm... Not sold on the design, but I bet it[n]could haul a load. I'll keep an eye on this[n]model next time I'm on the market.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Eh, that stuff's all gravy. What really[n]matters is if you like it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And, y'know... If the ladies feel the same.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Good point. A man's only as good as the[n]car he drives, huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Lesson learned! Thanks, Boss!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Interesting, a cat-shaped car...[n]Not a bad design, actually.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: If it's based on a cat, do you think the[n]seats are soft and furry? Maybe we[n]should take a look.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Yes... Fate wills it! Let's all get in and[n]fluff it up!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Is this the Phantom Thieves' car?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It looks so... normal.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Agreed. It's a bit cute for a group of[n]thieves.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Perhaps this is a form of camouflage.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Camouflage? This?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: As a normal car, it can drive around and[n]avoid detection... But when disaster[n]strikes, it changes into its true form.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh, I get it! It transforms into a giant[n]robot, right!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I suddenly feel like the bar's been[n]raised...
